column1: # Every field of the request and reply messages public contracts 1945423c
# and 5c2119f added or changed, and of the messages nested in their new
# replies. A guard test walks these messages and fails when a field is missing
# here or listed but gone, so no field of them is dropped by accident.
# covered: the SDK parameter (request) or model field (reply) that carries it.
# omitted: not exposed, with the reason.
